title: Chopta Tungnath
reportingPoint: Vaishali Metro Station, Delhi. Reporting time: 9:00 PM on the departure night.
highlights: Trek to Tungnath Mahadev Temple and Chandrashila Peak (weather permitting)
Trek to Deoriatal Lake from Sari Village
Devprayag, the confluence of the Bhagirathi and Alaknanda rivers
Forest walk and bonfire evening in Chopta
Stop in Rishikesh on the way back (if time permits)
2 nights in Swiss camps or a homestay
overview:
A trekking weekend in Uttarakhand: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** Chopta Tungnath group trip leaves Delhi at night and returns early in the morning after Day 3. You board the bus or traveller at Vaishali Metro Station (reporting 9:00 PM) and travel overnight.

Day 1 stops at Devprayag to see the confluence of the Bhagirathi and Alaknanda rivers, then continues to Chopta for a forest walk, a bonfire and a home-style dinner. Day 2 is the early-morning trek to Tungnath and Chandrashila Peak, weather permitting. Day 3 is the drive to Sari Village and the trek to Deoriatal Lake, followed by the return journey with a stop in Rishikesh if time permits. Transport, 2 nights in Swiss camps or a homestay, the listed veg meals and a trip captain or trek guide are included. Prices start at ₹6,499 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: You board the bus or traveller at Vaishali Metro Station, Delhi. Reporting time is 9:00 PM on the departure night, and the journey to Chopta is overnight.

faqs.q: How much does the Chopta Tungnath trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹6,499 per person on quad sharing, ₹6,999 on triple sharing and ₹7,499 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

Transportation from Delhi to Delhi by Tempo Traveller or cab, 2 nights in Swiss camps or a homestay, a trip captain or trek guide, a bonfire if the weather permits, local explorations as per the itinerary, driver allowances, tolls, parking and state taxes, and 24x7 customer support. Veg meals are 2 dinners, 2 breakfasts and 2 evening snacks, from evening snacks on Day 1 to breakfast on Day 3.

faqs.q: Which treks are part of the trip?
faqs.a: Day 2 is the early-morning trek to Tungnath and Chandrashila Peak, which depends on the weather. Day 3 has the trek from Sari Village to Deoriatal Lake and back. Wear comfortable trekking or sports shoes.
Both nights are in Chopta, in Swiss camps or a homestay. Room heaters are not included.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
